runner_diagnostic_driver_source:
"""Paired runner prefill diagnostic using frozen/candidate staged library bindings."""
import sys, ctypes, json, hashlib, statistics
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd(); sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts.gemma4_campaign_bench import DEFAULT_ARTIFACT, _resolve_generator, exact_prompt_ids, run_instrumented
from hipengine.kernels.hip_gfx1100.gemma4 import gemma4_attention_staged as staged
from hipengine.benchmark.provenance import collect_artifact_provenance
from scripts.gemma4_public_route_probe import observe_attention_launches
baseline=ctypes.CDLL(str(Path.home()/'.cache/hipengine/build/gemma4_attention_staged-513a6a8031b5fbbe/gemma4_attention_staged.so'))
candidate=staged.build_gemma4_attention_staged(load=True)
original=staged.build_gemma4_attention_staged
llm,runner,loading=_resolve_generator(DEFAULT_ARTIFACT,8255)
generator=llm._get_text_generator()
report={'kind':'gemma4_paired_staged_pv_runner_prefill_diagnostic',
        'protocol':'run_instrumented; fixed one output token; alternating AB/BA; no sampling/decode included; runner reset each request; 1 full-shape warmup per arm; 3 samples per arm',
        'scope':'Synthetic exact campaign prompt; runner phase latency, not a category-suite or public wall improvement claim. Both library bindings bypass repeated build resolution identically. Public default route checked separately.',
        'loading':loading,'provenance':collect_artifact_provenance(repo_root=ROOT, model_path=DEFAULT_ARTIFACT, quant='UD-Q4_K_XL',kv_dtype='bf16'),
        'libraries':{name:{'path':lib._name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(lib._name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name,lib in (('baseline',baseline),('candidate',candidate))},'cases':[]}
try:
 for prompt in (513,2053,8191):
  ids=exact_prompt_ids(generator.tokenize,prompt)
  arms={'baseline':baseline,'candidate':candidate};samples={name:[] for name in arms};calls={}
  for name,lib in arms.items():
   staged.build_gemma4_attention_staged=lambda **kwargs:lib
   run_instrumented(runner,ids,1)
  for repeat in range(3):
   names=list(arms) if repeat%2==0 else list(reversed(arms))
   for name in names:
    lib=arms[name];staged.build_gemma4_attention_staged=lambda **kwargs:lib
    with observe_attention_launches() as seen: row=run_instrumented(runner,ids,1)
    samples[name].append(row)
    calls[name]={'count':len(seen),'variants':sorted({x['variant'] for x in seen})}
    print(prompt,repeat,name,row['prefill_s'],row['generated_token_ids'],calls[name],flush=True)
  b=statistics.median(x['prefill_s'] for x in samples['baseline']);n=statistics.median(x['prefill_s'] for x in samples['candidate'])
  same=len({tuple(x['generated_token_ids']) for rows in samples.values() for x in rows})==1
  assert same and all(x['variants']==['gemma4_staged'] for x in calls.values())
  report['cases'].append({'prompt_tokens':prompt,'requested_output_tokens':1,'prompt_ids_sha256':hashlib.sha256(bytes(__import__('numpy').array(ids,dtype='int32'))).hexdigest(), 'samples':samples,'launches':calls,'baseline_prefill_s':b,'candidate_prefill_s':n,'candidate_over_baseline':n/b,'all_generated_ids_equal':same})
  Path('/tmp/priority-staged-pv-runner-pair.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
finally:
 staged.build_gemma4_attention_staged=original
 llm.close()
